records.text: Renee (commenter; surname unverified) writes: Charlie was killed soon after I lost my husband. I reached out to his first wife and your show bonded us. Today is her birthday.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

records.text: Renee (commenter; surname unverified) friend of Susanna (commenter's friend; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: We both always stay home, so I don't see her. Please wish Susanna (commenter's friend; surname unverified) happy birthday. We love you and all your hard work for Charlie.
